actual.titulo: Someone You Thought You Knew • The Lieutenant of Lampson Road
actual.descripcion: The Lieutenant of Lampson Road | Firefighter William Walker and his new wife, Uloma, live in a tight-knit Cleveland neighborhood, when he is gunned down in their driveway, turning everyone in his life into a suspect.

siguiente.titulo: Someone You Thought You Knew • The Thanksgiving Ambush
siguiente.descripcion: The Thanksgiving Ambush | Rob and Brenda Andrew, a devout couple living in the Bible Belt of Oklahoma City, find their world shattered when both of them are shot during a violent home invasion; the mastermind proves to be closer than anyone imagined.

Deadly Turn | A couple escapes the dangers of the big city and moves to the country; however, they begin to suspect their new neighbors are involved in the drug trade, leading to a bloody conflict with children caught in the crossfire.
Rural Madness | Differences over how to enjoy life in a rural neighborhood quickly escalate into a feud that comes to a bloody end on the road where it began.

lista.titulo: Fear Thy Neighbor • House of Shards
lista.descripcion: House of Shards | A childish joke between neighbor kids turns into an all-out war when the adults get involved; for some, the laughter will end forever.

lista.titulo: Fear Thy Neighbor • A Killer View
lista.descripcion: A Killer View | A young family builds their dream home in the Kentucky Hills, but their slice of heaven turns into a hellish experience for the quiet couple living next door; a dispute over a shared road leads to fireworks, fury and cold-blooded murder.

lista.titulo: A Killer Among Friends • Strike to Kill
lista.descripcion: Strike to Kill | When an Auburn University graduate disappears, her tight-knit group of friends falls under suspicion; as investigators chase leads and rumors spread, distrust grows, until new evidence reveals a truth about someone close to her.

Estreno ║ Dangerous To Love | A torrid affair between a body transporter and a coroner descends into a vicious act of revenge, while an obsessed young college student can't tolerate her ex-boyfriend dating someone else.

Estreno ║ Military veteran and father Re'Mano Campbell dies in a hail of gunfire inside his Alabama home. As detectives follow the evidence, each clue leads them deeper into a disturbing mystery and raises questions about how far the case reaches.
Bad Medicine | In 2015 Texas, aspiring rapper Daeveion Mangum seeks fame through risky choices, but one decision drags him into a deadly spiral of violence.

Club Chaos | Lima, Ohio police race to a chaotic scene at an after-hours nightclub following a shooting that leaves one person dead and multiple others injured; as they try to identify the shooter, dozens of patrons flee in fear, confusing first responders.

lista.titulo: The Murder Tapes • I Did Something Real Bad
lista.descripcion: I Did Something Real Bad | Police find Orlando Euell's body left for dead on the side of the road in Milwaukee; police examine extensive surveillance footage to learn about Orlando's last moments, including witnessing him get into the car that would take him to his death.

lista.titulo: The Murder Tapes • One in the Chamber
lista.descripcion: One in the Chamber | A retirement community in Evansville, Ind., reels when police find Odie Carrier Jr. mortally shot in his own home; puzzled even more by the surprising way he died, police must work quickly if they are going to find the person responsible.

lista.titulo: The Murder Tapes • Help, I've Been Shot
lista.descripcion: Help, I've Been Shot | Officers with the Evansville police department arrive at a crime scene to find a shooting victim barely alive and needing medical attention; the stakes get higher after they realize there might be another injured victim who's now missing.
